W4h visual hill climb STOPPED at v7 (branch claude/review-workbench @ b424df922, persisted; not on main).
Rounds v0..v7 on synthetic specimens only; 3 fresh critics per round (visual, function/a11y, target user).
Means v0->v6 (visual/function/user): 5.3/5.6/5.3 -> 6.9/6.4/6.7 -> 7.1/6.7/7.1 -> 7.4/6.6/7.1 ->
7.6/6.7/7.1 -> 7.4/6.9/7.1 -> 7.6/7.2/7.6. v7 = polish of v6's confirmed defects, gate-verified only
(48 tests OK; 28/28 SD1 mutants killed; 10 specimens 0 errors/failed/overflow); no independent v7 scores.
Budget: baseline+3 planned; rounds v4-v7 ran beyond it because acceptance blockers remained
(calibration blindness bypasses B3-B9, lost-functionality B10/B11, stranded evidence).
Design change found by the climb: calibration chosen by WORDS (fixed windows 1 + every 8th, masked;
whole-window monotonic reveal; late items excluded; threat model = inadvertent priming through UI).
Plan amendment drafted on claude/review-ui-plan-amend @ 85171c651, NOT landed: needs owner approval.
Owner decisions pending: amendment; whether to mask neighbouring windows.
Critic verdicts (v6): ready for owner pilot W4p and the real source pass; recall pass ready after the
stale-evidence fix (done in v7, not independently re-verified).
Evidence: scratchpad hill/ (critiques/, logs/, shots/, out/<round>); progress artifact
https://claude.ai/artifact/WzRQoBSAH1eSkvt6G7Ernt . Independent code review of server/store still owed
before W4p/landing (SD2/SD6).
